# Coverage reports (/offline_mod/content/v1/coverage, "coverage 1") that every reader must judge
# alike: the DLL's ParseCoverage (tests/test_main.cpp TestCoverageCorpus) and the acceptance
# harness's coverage command (BF-WorkingDirRust/scripts/content_provider_client_test.py, tested by
# test_content_harness_startup.py).  A reader may only call a report complete when everything it
# states proves it; a bare "complete 1" is never enough (Session 16 QC, 2026-10-20).
#
#   == <case name>
#   expect complete | incomplete | unreadable      (unreadable: not a report at all)
#   build <the client build the reader asked for>
#   <<<
#   <report lines>
#   >>>
#
# The body between <<< and >>> is joined with "\n" and ends with one "\n".

== a complete, consistent report
expect complete
build B1
<<<
bfcp 2
coverage 1
enabled 1
ready 1
epoch e1
generation 7
policy sha256:aaaa
manifest sha256:bbbb
manifest_build B1
client_build B1
build_match 1
unknown 0
excluded 3
inputs 1
I	localstate	Ver3275_hdt2N6mr_1.dat	sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
set background required 5 ok 5 absent 0 unowned 0 missing 0 ambiguous 0 unavailable 0
set login required 4 ok 4 absent 0 unowned 0 missing 0 ambiguous 0 unavailable 0
complete 1
end
>>>

== QC: a bare complete claim with no sets and no header
expect unreadable
build B1
<<<
bfcp 2
coverage 1
complete 1
generation 1
end
>>>

== an incomplete report with its problem rows and reason

set background required 5 ok 5 absent 0 unowned 0 missing 0 ambiguous 0 unavailable 0
set login required 4 ok 3 absent 0 unowned 1 missing 0 ambiguous 0 unavailable 0
complete 0
reason set login: 1 unowned
P	login	unowned	a.png
end
>>>
